name: Zombieman

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target over 3 hits.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 4500% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies in a row over 5 hits (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. For the first 7 turns, when using an Ultimate, has a 120% chance to inflict [Blind] on the primary target and 1 random enemy, lasting 1 turn. [Blind]: Reduces [Arena DMG Reduction]%, prevents the use of Ultimates, and disables Follow-Ups. This effect can exist up to 2 stacks at the same time and is treated as a [Stun-type effect].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 6000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies in a row over 5 hits (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. For the first 7 turns, when using an Ultimate, has a 180% chance to inflict [Blind] on the primary target and 1 random enemy, lasting 1 turn. Grants all allies 15% [Enrage] and [Armor Break]. [Blind]: Reduces [Arena DMG Reduction] by 30%, prevents the use of Ultimates, and disables Follow-Ups. This effect can exist up to 2 stacks at the same time and is treated as a [Stun-type effect].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Immune to [Blind]. Before any character takes action, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], [Intimidation], and [Silence] from all allies. At the start of Turn 3, removes [HP Link] from all enemies. For the first 4 turns, allies in the same column spend 0 Energy when using their Ultimate.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Immune to [Blind]. Before any character takes action, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], [Intimidation], and [Silence] from all allies. At the start of Turn 3, removes [HP Link] from all enemies. For the first 5 turns, allies in the same column spend 0 Energy when using their Ultimate.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Immune to [Blind]. Before any character takes action, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], [Intimidation], and [Silence] from all allies. At the start of Turn 3, removes [HP Link] from all enemies. For the first 6 turns, allies in the same column spend 0 Energy when using their Ultimate.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Triggers [Specialized Regeneration] upon taking a fatal hit. After triggering [Specialized Regeneration], this unit is immune to all DMG until the end of the turn. [Specialized Regeneration]: Upon activation, permanently reduces DMG taken by 30%. While at least one ally remains on the field, restores 100% HP before the next action and continues fighting. Also gains 15% Attack and 30% Max HP (stackable) each time it triggers. Can activate up to 3 times.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Triggers [Specialized Regeneration] upon taking a fatal hit. After triggering [Specialized Regeneration], this unit is immune to all DMG until the end of the turn. When an ally in the same row triggers [Re-battle], if this unit is in the [Specialized Regeneration] state, launches a [Charged Pursuit] with 120% skill strength. [Specialized Regeneration]: Upon activation, permanently reduces DMG taken by 60%. While at least one ally remains on the field, restores 100% HP before the next action and continues fighting. Also gains 15% Attack and 30% Max HP (stackable) each time it triggers. Can activate up to 4 times.

bio: A new URplus awakening of Zombieman — the “Heavy Vanguard” (重装先锋): an undying Duelist frontline that cleanses crowd-control for the team, blinds and pierces enemy defenses, and revives with stacking ATK/HP. CV: Takahiro Sakurai.
